```{python}
# | code-fold: true

# Helpers shared by the CCL halo mass function pages. Each page defines, before
# including this file: PAIRS, a list of (label, function returning a new pair);
# ENTRY_LABEL, the table header for the labels; PLOT_GRID and PLOT_FIGSIZE, the
# subplot grid and figure size of plot_entries; and m_arr, Z_ARR, Z_STYLES and
# PRECISION_SETS. PARAMETERS_SET and COLORS come from _setup_models.qmd.


def compare_entry(compare_func, pair_factory, model, name, z):
    """Compare one entry in one cosmology at one redshift."""
    ccl_hmf, nc_mulf = pair_factory()
    return compare_func(
        model["CCL"], model["NC"], ccl_hmf, nc_mulf, m_arr, z, model=name
    )


def compare_all(compare_func):
    """Compare every entry, cosmology, redshift and precision setting."""
    return {
        (prec, z): [
            [
                compare_entry(compare_func, factory, m, name, z)
                for m, name in zip(model_set, PARAMETERS_SET)
            ]
            for _, factory in PAIRS
        ]
        for prec, model_set in PRECISION_SETS
        for z in Z_ARR
    }


def plot_entries(comparisons, prec, x_label, y_label):
    """Plot the relative difference for each entry at one precision setting."""
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(
        *PLOT_GRID, sharex=True, figsize=PLOT_FIGSIZE, squeeze=False
    )
    for i, (ax, (label, _)) in enumerate(zip(axs.flat, PAIRS)):
        ax.set_title(label, fontsize=9)
        entry = [p for z in Z_ARR for p in comparisons[(prec, z)][i]]
        if all(p.rel_diff_max == 0.0 for p in entry):
            # A log scale cannot show a difference that is zero everywhere.
            ax.text(
                0.5,
                0.5,
                "relative difference 0\nat every point",
                ha="center",
                va="center",
                transform=ax.transAxes,
                fontsize=8,
            )
            continue
        for z, ls in zip(Z_ARR, Z_STYLES):
            for p, c in zip(comparisons[(prec, z)][i], COLORS):
                ax.plot(
                    p.x,
                    p.abs_diff,
                    lw=0.8,
                    color=c,
                    linestyle=ls,
                    label=p.model if z == Z_ARR[0] else None,
                )
        ax.set_xscale("log")
        ax.set_yscale("log")
        ax.grid()

    for ax in axs[-1, :]:
        ax.set_xlabel(x_label)
    axs[0, 0].legend(loc="best", fontsize=7)
    fig.supylabel(y_label)
    fig.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
    plt.close()


def summary_table(comparisons, stat_header):
    """Display one row per precision setting, entry, cosmology and redshift."""
    table = []
    for prec, _ in PRECISION_SETS:
        for z in Z_ARR:
            for (label, _), entry in zip(PAIRS, comparisons[(prec, z)]):
                for p in entry:
                    # row[0] is the cosmology, passed to the comparison as model=.
                    row = p.summary_row(convert_g=False)
                    table.append([prec, label, row[0], f"{z:g}"] + row[2:])

    df = pd.DataFrame(
        table, columns=["Precision", ENTRY_LABEL, "Cosmology", "$z$"] + stat_header
    )
    display(Markdown(df.to_markdown(index=False, colalign=["left"] * len(df.columns))))


def worst(comparisons, prec, i):
    """Largest relative difference of entry i at one precision setting."""
    return max(p.rel_diff_max for z in Z_ARR for p in comparisons[(prec, z)][i])


def worst_table(mf_comparisons, fs_comparisons):
    """Display the largest relative difference per entry, quantity and setting."""
    rows = []
    for i, (label, _) in enumerate(PAIRS):
        row = [label]
        for comparisons in (mf_comparisons, fs_comparisons):
            for prec, _ in PRECISION_SETS:
                value = latex_float(worst(comparisons, prec, i), convert_g=False)
                row.append(f"${value}$")
        rows.append(row)

    df = pd.DataFrame(
        rows,
        columns=[ENTRY_LABEL]
        + [
            rf"{quantity}, {prec}"
            for quantity in (r"$\mathrm{d}n/\mathrm{d}\ln M$", r"$f(\sigma)$")
            for prec, _ in PRECISION_SETS
        ],
    )
    display(Markdown(df.to_markdown(index=False, colalign=["left"] * len(df.columns))))
```
